Answer ID: 29954 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 306/225/L=1432) The drops that usually come out after urine are called wadi that does not make ghusl wajib. It is only enough to wash the part. Yes if the penis is erect and drops discharge with lust, then ghusl shall be wajib. You can decide about yourself based upon the above mentioned details. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
